question: Should Crabbox accept fal Compute as a built-in direct SSH lease provider through https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/693, and what live-proof bar is required before merge?
rationale: Adding a billable remote provider creates new provider surface, config, credential handling, and cleanup semantics; automation should not decide the product acceptance or waive funded-provider proof.

options.title: Require proof before merge
options.body: Keep the issue open and require the linked PR to resolve conflicts, correctness findings, and full redacted live lifecycle proof before landing.

options.title: Waive the funded proof gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept first-use risk for fal Compute and land after ordinary review without full create/use/destroy proof.

options.title: Defer built-in fal support
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR and leave this issue as the place to revisit fal only when API and ownership details are ready.

recommendation.title: Require proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require the linked PR to resolve conflicts, correctness findings, and full redacted live lifecycle proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider lifecycle, credential-redaction, release, and registry history make this the strongest available owner signal for the product/proof decision.
